finding_fixed_here.finding: [minor] clipping - at 760 the header 'Back to ...' button ellipsized its label while ~170-190px of empty header sat immediately to its right, dropping the words that carry the meaning ('Back to AI Brains & ...' lost 'Providers'). Present on all sixteen non-home 760 shots of the audited themes.
finding_fixed_here.root_cause: .c05.is-narrow .c05-back-label carried an unconditional max-width:120px. The clamp was width-class driven, not space driven, so it fired whenever the layout was narrow regardless of how much room the row actually had. The full label needs only 17-37px more than the clamped width, against 168-186px of free space.
finding_fixed_here.fix: Removed the fixed clamp. .c05-back-label now carries overflow:hidden + text-overflow:ellipsis with min-width:max-content, so at rest it always renders its whole text (the max-content floor also defeats the sub-pixel flex rounding that would otherwise paint a spurious ellipsis, the same hazard the crumb trail hit). .c05-back is pinned flex:0 0 auto so the button can never be flex-shaved out from under its own text. The row's real yielders go first: the topbar search field already shrinks at flex-shrink 4 to its 170px floor, then the crumb trail truncates via syncCrumbTight(). Only a shortfall that survives both reaches the label: the new syncBackFit() measures the trailing element's overhang past the header's content edge and, if positive, adds .is-back-tight (which releases the max-content floor) and assigns an integer max-width equal to the overhang, never taking the label below a 96px floor that keeps 'Back to' plus the leading word readable. The button's title attribute already carries the full text for that case. The two clamps can never chase each other: syncTopFit() clears the Back clamp, runs the crumb pass, then runs the Back pass, so every measurement is taken from the fully untruncated state. syncTopFit() replaced syncCrumbTight() at both call sites (updateLayout, renderTop).
finding_fixed_here.measured_after: CDP geometry probe over all 8 themes x the 4 non-home routes at 760 (32 cases): label.scrollWidth == clientWidth in every one (truncated=false, .is-back-tight never set), labels reading in full as 'Back to Settings Home' / 'Back to AI Brains & Providers'. Button widths 164-215px depending on theme font; the freed space now sits in the flexible spacer (113-184px), and the trailing element lands exactly on the header content edge (lastRight == contentRight == 748) with docOverflow 0 in all 32. Pixel decode of the regenerated shots agrees: basic-dark-760 dest/ai back box x48-224 with ink to x213 (was box x48-207, ink ending x174 at an ellipsis), retro-light-760 manager/m.providers box x48-246 with ink to x235 (was 48-209 / ink 181).
finding_fixed_here.still_ellipsizes_when_genuinely_tight: At 520 the cascade is visible in order: the search field is at its 170px floor first, and only then does the label clamp (truncated=true, .is-back-tight set, 'Back to AI Brai...'), with the row still fitting inside the header padding and docOverflow 0.
